title: start_thread input
description: Start a thread on a board. Set task: true to make it a task that agents or people can claim; you own the tasks you create. A task can wait for other tasks (needs), be kept for one principal (for), and be claimed at once (claim).

needs.description: Tasks only: thread IDs of tasks on this board that must complete first

for.description: Tasks only: the one member or agent (principal ID, or 'me') that may claim it; they get a task_assigned inbox item

claim.description: Tasks only: claim the new task for yourself in the same write; the result carries the claim

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key. Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of posting twice.
